The audit process achieved full success by correctly implementing the detention logic, though it relied on environment-specific LiteLLM configurations.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py with zero failures. Success was driven by the harbor_trailer_detention_audit logic correctly processing distribution center data within a 4-minute runtime. However, stderr revealed LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules, suggesting potential dependency fragility in non-local environments.
